panels.title: Pipelines — current SLA state (0=ok, 1=at risk, 2=breached)
panels.description: Reads pipeline_current_sla_status (schema.sql) - the worst currently-active rule per pipeline across not_started/running_too_long/finished_late/freshness_breach/dq_failed/upstream_blocked.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.pipeline_id, CASE sla.overall_result WHEN 'breached' THEN 2 WHEN 'at_risk' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS state FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN pipeline_current_sla_status sla ON sla.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.enabled ORDER BY state DESC, p.pipeline_id

panels.title: Daily SLA compliance % (all rule evaluations)
panels.description: Before this dashboard's build date, sla_engine only ever wrote a row on breach (no resolving 'ok' row) - so days before the fix show artificially low compliance, since only failures were ever recorded, not health. Trust this trend going forward from the fix date; treat earlier days as historically incomplete, not a real compliance drop.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', evaluated_at) AS time, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE result != 'breached') / GREATEST(count(*), 1), 2) AS compliance_pct FROM sla_evaluation WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Duration vs SLA, and 30-day miss rate
panels.description: Per-pipeline average/p95 run duration and SLA miss rate over the last 30 days (sla_evaluation), next to each pipeline's configured SLA target - use this to spot pipelines trending toward breach even if they haven't breached yet.

targets.rawSql: WITH dur AS (SELECT pipeline_id, round(avg(duration_s)) AS avg_duration_s, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_s)) AS p95_duration_s, count(*) AS runs_30d FROM pipeline_run WHERE started_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND duration_s IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pipeline_id), miss AS (SELECT pipeline_id, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'breached') / GREATEST(count(*), 1), 2) AS miss_pct FROM sla_evaluation WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY pipeline_id) SELECT p.pipeline_id, p.tier, (p.sla_json->>'max_duration_minutes') AS sla_max_duration_min, (p.sla_json->>'freshness_target_minutes') AS sla_freshness_target_min, dur.avg_duration_s, dur.p95_duration_s, dur.runs_30d, COALESCE(miss.miss_pct, 0) AS miss_pct_30d FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN dur ON dur.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id LEFT JOIN miss ON miss.pipeline_id = p.pipeline_id WHERE p.enabled ORDER BY p.tier, p.pipeline_id
